title: potentilla arenaria subsp. tommasiniana
intro: Potentilla arenaria subsp. tommasiniana, commonly known as Rock Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fighting against infections, thus providing health benefits such as wound healing and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cinquefoil are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating skin conditions and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
